subject: Data Engineering
title: Kappa Architecture
description: A short lesson to help you apply Kappa Architecture.

hook.text: Why maintain two codebases when streaming can handle everything? Kappa architecture uses one path for all data.

buildup.text: Kappa processes all data through a single streaming pipeline. Historical reprocessing replays the stream.

discovery.text: By treating batch as a special case of streaming, Kappa eliminates the duplicate logic problem of Lambda.

twist.text: Kappa struggles when batch reprocessing is genuinely cheaper or when streaming tools can't handle the volume.

climax.text: Kappa works best when your streaming framework is mature enough to replay and reprocess at batch-like scale.

punchline.text: One pipeline for everything. Simpler when it fits.

quiz.question: How does Kappa architecture simplify Lambda?
options: By using a single streaming pipeline for all processing
